newsitem.title: USA: Harborside Healthcare buys four facilities.
newsitem.headline: Harborside Healthcare buys four facilities.

text.p: Harborside Healthcare Corp said Monday it will buy four nursing homes from Cushman Management Associates in Massachusetts.
The company said the four facilities, located in the northeast suburbs of Boston, had revenues of about $18 million in 1996. They have a total of 401 beds.
The company would not disclose a purchase price, and said Cushman Management is privately owned.
The company said the completion of the purchase is contingent upon the receipt of regulatory approval, which is expected by August 1997.
The company also said it completed the acquisition of Harford Gardens Nursing and Restorative Center effective March 1, 1997.
The company said Harford Gardens is licensed for 163 beds and had revenues of approximately $7 million in 1996. It is located in Baltimore.
The company declined to disclose the purchase price on the acquisition, and said Hartford Gardens was privately owned.
